description: This file defines the PayloadSizeFilter class, a servlet filter that enforces maximum payload size limits on HTTP requests based on URL patterns. It initializes size limits from a configuration string, checks request payload sizes, and handles exceptions when limits are exceeded.

classes.name: PayloadSizeFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that limits the size of request payloads based on URL patterns, throwing an exception if the payload exceeds configured limits.

methods.name: PayloadSizeFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes size limits from a configuration string.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Overrides the filter method to check payload size limits before passing the request along.

methods.name: checkMaxPayloadSizeExceeded
methods.description: Checks if the request payload exceeds the maximum allowed size and handles the exception if so.

methods.name: shouldNotFilterAsyncDispatch
methods.description: Indicates whether to filter async dispatches; returns false.

methods.name: shouldNotFilterErrorDispatch
methods.description: Indicates whether to filter error dispatches; returns false.

methods.name: handleMaxPayloadSizeExceededException
methods.description: Sets the response status to 413 Payload Too Large and writes the exception message.
